mentions.name: Media Den
mentions.description: A privacy-by-design iOS photo and video vault with bring-your-own-storage, end-to-end encrypted media (config stored in the secure enclave, encrypted cached data and cloud-side storage), multi-cloud replication with replica-to-primary promotion, proximity-based offline file sharing using ephemeral keys with man-in-the-middle protection, metadata removal, PIN auto-lock, privacy blur on app switching, and zero telemetry with no servers in the loop.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made Media Den, a privacy-by-design iOS photo and video vault.
mentions.author: ryanisnan
